description:
A walk through a sample missed-call follow-up list for an invented plumbing company, the kind of report the pilot makes for home services businesses: open leads ranked by urgency, and a draft reply for each.

Missed-Call and Web-Inquiry Follow-Up List: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

narration: If you run a plumbing or heating business, how many missed calls never got a call back?
Here's a sample list for an invented plumbing company. Twelve missed calls and four web inquiries became seven open leads, ranked by urgency.
A message that mentions a gas smell gets no written draft. It goes to the top, for a person to call back now.
Every other open lead gets a draft reply, written for you to review and send yourself. Amber never calls or texts your customers.
